name: Guest Investor Programme

requirements.blocker_text: Minimum EUR250,000 in investment certificates issued by one of two government-approved real estate funds, retained for at least 5 years.
The qualifying investment must be completed within 3 months of the guest-investor visa being issued, and within 3 months of entering Hungary.
Minimum EUR1,000,000 donation to a foundation managing a state-recognised Hungarian higher-education institution.
The qualifying donation must be completed within 3 months of the guest-investor visa being issued, and within 3 months of entering Hungary.

evidence_required.document: Investment fund certificate or donation confirmation

outcome.duration_length: residence permit valid up to 10 years, extendable once for another 10 years
outcome.physical_presence_requirement: none confirmed -- the tier-1 FAQ explicitly states there is no rule regarding a minimum length of stay in Hungary

sources.title: National Directorate-General for Aliens Policing (OIF) -- Guest Investor Visa and Permit FAQ: 6-month non-extendable visa then 10+10 year residence permit, 3-month investment-completion window, no minimum stay, family reunification process

International Bar Association -- The latest updates to the Guest Investor Residency Programme: EUR250,000 real-estate-fund and EUR1,000,000 education-donation thresholds; discontinued direct-property and government-bond options

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Hungary's initial build. STATUS SET TO DRAFT: the tier-1 FAQ confirms the programme's structure (visa then 10+10yr permit, 3-month investment window, no minimum-stay rule, family process) but omits the specific investment AMOUNTS -- those hard-requirement figures are tier-3 only (International Bar Association), pending tier-1 confirmation. Per the tier-3 source, two other options existed historically but are now discontinued and NOT modelled as active: a direct real-estate-purchase option (cancelled before 2025) and a government-bond option (ended July 2024, predating the current Guest Investor Programme entirely). leads_to_pr set false because the 10(+10)-year permit duration already functions as a long-duration status in its own right rather than converting to a separate permanent-residence product; whether guest-investor time counts toward hu_national_residence_card's 3-year continuous-residence ground was not confirmed at tier-1. Family members apply for family reunification in parallel but cannot lawfully remain until the principal's own permit is granted, per the tier-1 FAQ.
